overviewText:
CureMD Electronic Health Information Export

Overview
System administrators can initiate EHI export for a single patient or for all patients at any time through the application's EHI Export module.

Single Patient Export
Single patient export can be initiated through the application, without any developer assistance. Once the requested EHI is extracted, users can download the files through the provided link.

Population Export
Users can submit a request for population export from within the application. Subsequent updates will be provided to the user over email.

Export Formats
Export formats include both CSV (Comma-Separated Values) files as well as the native format of documents attached to the patient chart. These files will be made available to the requester in ZIP format. The DRS tab in this Excel sheet provides details about the available data classes. This documentation is available at the publicly accessible hyperlink provided below.
https://www.curemd.com/ehi-export.asp
